description: A seller's receiving address on Borro: put it as payTo in your x402 offers (or as a payment channel's receiver, or a Borro hold's payee) and whatever USDG it is paid is swept into Borro's USDG vault, bUSDG, straight to the owner's wallet, so takings earn until spent. Gives the address (one per owner, known before it is made), whether it is made, the USDG waiting there, the owner's bUSDG and its worth, and the x402 fields to use. Pass wallet (the owner), or address (a receiving address, to find its owner).

address.description: Or a receiving address (0x...), to read it and its owner
